user.title: Connect your AlphaESS portal
user.description: Use the owner account that can use Discharge now on the AlphaESS portal Dashboard. Enter the inverter serial number shown there.

error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected these credentials or this account cannot access the device.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read this inverter from the portal. Check the serial number and connection.

abort.cannot_connect: The previous portal configuration could not be imported. Set up the integration through the UI.

init.title: Discharge settings
init.description: Changes apply on the next start or renewal. Power is battery output, not guaranteed grid export. Default expiry is five minutes.
